hero.meta: 07 dossiers · From €38 · Ships from Porto in 5 days

featured_product.title: Field Tote
featured_product.lede: Top carry. The piece every other dossier locks into. Anchor-Latch compatible with every component of the system, finished in Porto.

featured_dossiers.title: Edition 01 — four anchor pieces
featured_dossiers.lede: The shortest path from arrival to packing. Each dossier numbered, finished in Porto, allocation live.

trust_strip.origin_detail: Cut, stitched, inspected by hand at Atelier Souto.
trust_strip.allocation_detail: Edition 01 — Strait of Gibraltar. Issued in series.
trust_strip.returns_detail: Anchor-Latch hardware repaired for the lifetime of the kit.

manifesto.body: Travel is a system. A pouch is not a pouch — it is a slot. A cube is not a cube — it is a discipline. Manifest Office issues the system, in numbered editions, finished by hand in Porto.

edition_feature.title: Gibraltar to Porto, twelve months in the open.
edition_feature.body: Edition 01 closes when the 1,200th system ships. Every dossier carries the issue number, the maker initial, and the finishing date. Edition 02 opens on the same day.

process.step_one_body: Brief opens in Gibraltar with a fixed weight budget, fixed colorway, fixed material stack.
process.step_two_body: Porto atelier cuts, stitches and finishes each dossier against the brief, numbered as it leaves the bench.
process.step_three_body: Reserved through the storefront, shipped within the quarter, traceable for the lifetime of the edition.

practitioners.title: Three hands, three benches.
practitioners.body: Cristina, Joana, and Marc finish every dossier in the edition. Each piece carries the maker initial on the inside seam.

final_reserve.eyebrow_open: Edition 01 · Still open · Issuing from Porto
final_reserve.subtitle: Reserve before the edition closes.

desk_teaser.title: A trip in. A packing list out.
desk_teaser.body: Tell the desk where you are going and how long. It will brief the dossiers you need for the kit and the order they pack.

desk_brief.form_lede: Where, when, for how long. The desk will reply with a packing list using the dossiers available in Edition 01.
desk_brief.field_purpose_placeholder: Working trip, surf trip, family visit, …

email_capture.title: Earliest access when Edition 02 opens.
email_capture.lede: Edition 02 is not announced. The list closes when Edition 01 closes.
email_capture.success: On the list — see you when Edition 02 opens.
email_capture.error_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid email.

pdp.engraving_helper: Letters, numbers, dots and dashes only.
pdp.sold_out_body: Join the Edition 02 list — earliest access when the next edition opens.
pdp.dossier_body: The {title} dossier — provenance, field notes, and operator credentials — expands in Wave 4. The skeleton is shipped now so the URL is stable for SEO and agentic-commerce crawlers.
pdp.engraving_helper_pattern: Letters, numbers, dots and dashes only.

exploded_kit.lede: Seven pieces. One latch. The interactive viewer assembles the kit in your browser at sixty frames a second.

scroll_latch.beat_1_body: Brass, cold-forged in Porto. Hand-finished, lacquer-free.
scroll_latch.beat_2_body: A quarter-turn closes the case. No springs, no plastic.
scroll_latch.beat_3_body: O-ring tension keeps the slot screw seated through 2,400-mile rotations.
scroll_latch.beat_4_body: Field-serviceable with the blade of a coin.
scroll_latch.beat_5_body: Every component carries a serial. Every component is replaceable.

wishlist.empty_title: Tap the heart on any dossier to save it for later.

build_notes.trigger_aria: Open build notes — guided tour of what was built
build_notes.feature_webgl_desc: Three.js plane, pointer Gaussian bulge, signal-orange ink fog
build_notes.feature_scrolly_desc: 193-frame AVIF sequence, sticky canvas, scroll-driven frame index
build_notes.feature_exploded_desc: Drag-orbit, EXPLODE / ASSEMBLE toggle, seven labelled parts
build_notes.feature_wishlist_desc: LocalStorage, cross-tab sync, ?w= share link, drawer carousel
build_notes.feature_quickadd_desc: Card-anchored on desktop, slide-up on mobile, haptic on add
build_notes.feature_carousel_desc: Hero + alt-angle thumbs, click to swap, all paper-backdrop typology
build_notes.feature_allocation_desc: Shopify metafield write, real-time across visitors, JSON-LD availability
build_notes.feature_i18n_desc: next-intl routing, 4 locales, per-market currency, hreflang matrix
build_notes.source_repo_meta: MIT · public · CI on every push (typecheck · lint · format · build)
build_notes.source_maelify_meta: Jose Galiano — Shopify Plus architect · headless commerce · AI-native UX
build_notes.source_disclaimer: This site is a portfolio piece. The brand "Manifest Office" is fictional. The commerce wiring, the imagery, the analytics fanout, the WebGL, the AI endpoints and the build infrastructure are real and shipping.
